title: Aina Ring: A $399 Tap-to-Approve Remote for Your AI Agents
dek: A titanium smart ring that lets you say yes or no to AI agents without a phone.
caption:
Your AI agents are fast. You're the slow part. One startup wants to fix that with a ring 💍

Aina just unveiled the Aina Ring, a $399 titanium smart ring that pairs with your Mac and iPhone. It shows agent requests on a tiny display, and a joystick-style button lets you approve or reject them in one flick. It learns from your calendar, location, email and apps like Uber and Spotify to suggest "Cues," like booking your usual ride or emailing that you're late for a Zoom call.

Founder Apoorv Shankar, former VP of hardware at Ultrahuman, isn't trying to replace your phone the way the Humane AI Pin and Rabbit R1 tried. The ring is meant to sit alongside it. Preorders are open now, with shipping planned for January 2027.

We're following the AI wearables race closely at AI Parabellum. Would you trust a ring to green-light your AI agents?

post_caption:
Approving AI agents could soon take one flick of your finger. The new Aina Ring puts a small display and a yes-or-no button on a titanium band, so tasks like booking an Uber or starting your music don't require pulling out your phone.

It's $399 on preorder, works only with Mac and iPhone for now, and ships in January 2027. Privacy and app support will decide if it sticks.
